results.title: PM Narendra Modi's Economic Advisor Sanjeev Sanyal reacts to 'Dhurandhar' being called propaganda film: 'Let a hundred flowers bloom'
results.description: Economist Sanjeev Sanyal champions the importance of artistic expression in cinema alongside the freedom of audience choice. He emphasizes that filmmakers should share their visions without fear of censorship. His literary work, 'The Revolutionaries,' is being transformed into a series for Prime Video. This adaptation delves into the intricacies of India's armed struggle for freedom and its diverse revolutionaries, set to debut on September 11.
